name: Suite 5: Chef Meal Management and Menu Operations

planSteps.description: Navigate to /dev-login/chef to authenticate as chef
The chef dashboard loads showing the chef header or kitchen overview metrics
The chef meals list renders with existing meals
The meal creation form is visible with name, category, and price fields
Submit the form without filling required fields
Validation feedback prevents submission or shows required field indicators
Navigate to /chef/meals/3/edit to edit an existing meal
The meal edit form displays with the prefilled meal details
The chef earnings metrics page loads successfully
